title: Multi-Location Martial Arts Software: Costs (2026)
description: What a 2nd school costs: Dojo Champ $199/mo, Martialytics $199, Gymdesk +$50, PushPress 17% off, Wodify per location; Spark, Kicksite, Zen Planner quote.
h1: Martial arts software for multiple locations
body:
Opening a second school changes what you need from your software. You want one student list, one login, and reports you can read per school and in total. You also want to know what the second location adds to your bill. Some vendors charge nothing extra, some charge a fixed add-on, some charge a full second plan, and some only quote on a sales call.

We checked each vendor's own pricing, help and product pages on November 20, 2026. We haven't run a multi-location school on these tools ourselves, and we don't publish ratings. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. Prices are in USD.

What a second location costs, by vendor

The last column is a worked example: two schools with 120 active students each (240 in total), paying monthly. We applied each vendor's published rules. We didn't include card processing fees or taxes.

How we worked out the example

  • Dojo Champ: one $199/mo plan with unlimited students, and its FAQ says multi-location support is included. No extra-location fee is listed.
  • Martialytics: pricing is by active students, and every plan lists "Unlimited locations". We assumed both schools' students sit on one account, which puts 240 students in the 200+ tier at $199/mo. Ask Martialytics to confirm this before you sign up.
  • Gymdesk: all locations share one member database, so 240 members falls in the Large Gym tier (151-250 members): $200/mo with Gymdesk Payments or $240/mo with your own processor. Add one extra location at $50 or $100. Over 250 members, Gymdesk's Enterprise tier is priced on a call.
  • PushPress: you pay per location, and extra locations get 17% off. On Pro that's $159 + $131.97 = $290.97/mo. On Max it's $229 + $190.07 = $419.07/mo. That's our math from the published 17% figure, so check the exact amount on your quote.
  • Wodify: the offer page says "starting at $199 $99/month per location" for sign-ups by November 30, 2026, so two locations on Essentials cost $398/mo at list or $198/mo with the offer. Wodify also charges an onboarding fee, but it doesn't publish the amount.
  • Mindbody: Starter is from $79/mo per location, and Mindbody says subscription prices rise with new locations, not with staff.

Things to check before you add a second school

  • One account or two? Gymdesk, Spark, Wodify, Kicksite and Dojo Champ all describe running every location from one login. Wodify also lets you split a location into its own separate account later. Its help center says that takes 1-4 weeks and carries a setup fee.
  • Separate bank accounts. Wodify lets you use one merchant setup for all locations or a separate one per location, so each school's payments land in its own bank account. Ask the other vendors how they handle this if your schools are separate businesses.
  • What can be set per location. Wodify's help center lists limits worth asking any vendor about: in Wodify, no-show and late-cancel policies, waivers and automated emails can't be set per location, and staff at any location can view every client.
  • Student count rules. If you're priced by active students (Martialytics, Kicksite, Gymdesk, Zen Planner), ask whether students who train at both schools count once or twice.
  • Card fees grow with you. With two schools, processing fees can cost more than the software. PushPress publishes 4.99%, 2.89% or 2.75% + $0.30 per card payment depending on the plan. Compare rates on our martial arts billing software page.
  • Time-limited offers. Spark's pricing page shows a Black Friday offer of 50% off for 12 months plus 8 weeks free, for new schools only, ending December 4, 2026. Wodify's $100-a-month discount needs a sign-up by November 30, 2026. Check whether an offer covers every location or just the first.

Tools we left out: MatPilot, MatGoat, MAAT and RhinoFit don't say on their pricing pages how they price or handle more than one location. Ask them directly if you're considering them.

faq: Which martial arts software doesn't charge extra for a second location?

Dojo Champ says multi-location support is included in its flat $199/mo plan (dojochamp.com/pricing FAQ), and Martialytics lists unlimited locations on every student-count plan (martialytics.com/pricing). Both checked 2026-11-20.
How much does Gymdesk charge per extra location?

Your first location is included. Each extra location is $50/mo with Gymdesk Payments or a preferred partner, or $100/mo with your own processor, and all locations share one member database (gymdesk.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-20).
Yes. Free ($0), Pro ($159/mo) and Max ($229/mo) are priced per location, and additional locations get 17% off (pushpress.com karate-taekwondo page, checked 2026-11-20).
How does Zen Planner price multiple locations?

Zen Planner says multi-location gyms are priced on the number of locations and active members across the business, with exact numbers given on a demo. It doesn't publish multi-location prices (zenplanner.com/pricing FAQ, checked 2026-11-20).
Can Spark Membership or Kicksite run several schools?

Yes. Spark describes a multi-school dashboard to manage multiple schools from one account, and Kicksite added switching between locations without separate logins in 2025. Neither publishes what extra schools cost.
